supporting_text_locations.own_summary: Describes the Burdekin river course and regional flow behaviour.
Identifies Burdekin Falls as storage on the Burdekin River and distinguishes lower-river irrigation schemes.
Names Suttor, Cape and Burdekin gauges upstream of the storage, without identifying the selected southern feeder geometry.
Separately describes the region, basins and rivers, including Gilbert and Mitchell, and their seasonal and braided character.
Separately names Gilbert and Einasleigh in flood discussion and describes regional estuarine wetlands; this is contextual evidence, not reach-boundary mapping.

sources.short_label_scope: Observed channel labels support only the generalized mapped corridor associations explained in findings.json. They are not assigned across every selected graph fragment.
sources.legend_interpretation: River lines, lake/storage water, catchment/region boundaries, roads, settlement points and irrigation/conservation shading are distinct map layers.
sources.source_limit: One coarse-scale official assessment. Repeated figures and supporting prose do not independently corroborate names or establish current exact naming boundaries.

availability_scope_note: Complete target regions have usable retained map coverage. All three bounded assessments are complete. Per-reach naming limits are explicit and outside the completed representative-system scope; none is described as access-pending.
included_evidence_limit: The included files contain bibliography, bounded identity facts and own observations. The complete baseline coordinate paths, original publication, inspection images and private verification are excluded. Public offline checks cannot reproduce the omitted whole-path or map-pixel comparisons.
